summary: First end-to-end test iteration for PokeBinder. 20/20 backend pytest tests pass against the public URL. Full UI flow (login, search, card detail +/- persistence, wishlist, sets, set detail with goals, goals page, collection stats, pokedex, scanner single+batch, settings index status, user isolation via register+logout) all pass against the deployed Kubernetes preview. Scanner recognises /app/tests/scan_sample_furret.jpg as swsh3-136 with top-level confidence='high' and the frontend auto-navigates to /card/swsh3-136 in single mode. User isolation verified both at API (user A's added card not visible to B) and UI level.

issues: React console warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Comes from <select><option>{it.matches.name}</option></select> where the dev instrumentation wraps the dynamic text in a <span>. Harmless in production build (no x-source spans) but worth noting - a safer fix is to render match name as a label alongside the <select>, or make options use primitive strings only.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan context manager.
CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' and allow_credentials=False - fine for current Bearer-token auth, but if cookies are ever used, origins must be explicit.

auth.py login_attempts rate-limit uses request.client.host which behind an ingress is often the proxy IP, making the per-identifier lockout coarse (all users behind same NAT share counters). Consider X-Forwarded-For.
/api/sets fetches every series + all cards per set via tcgdex and can be slow on cold cache (~tens of seconds on first call). Already tolerated with 120s client timeout; consider pre-warming.
scanner.recognize is called synchronously inside the request; large batches could tie up event loop. Current single-image path is OK.

frontend/.env is deleted inside Dockerfile before `yarn build`; good, but the compose build arg REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL defaults to "" which means the built SPA will call relative /api (works because nginx proxies). Document this clearly.
test_credentials: admin@pokebinder.local / admin123 (works). Dynamic TEST users created via /api/auth/register.
seed_data_creation: Admin user is auto-seeded on backend startup. Tests create ephemeral test_a_*/test_b_* users and add swsh3-136 to user A collection + swsh3 goal; wishlist entry is toggled off. No manual seeding required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is the regression harness - runs in ~8s with pytest-xdist. Scanner response has confidence as a TOP-LEVEL field (not inside matches[0]). Register endpoint lowercases email, so compare lowercased. First call to /api/sets or /api/sets/swsh3 can be slow (cold tcgdex cache) - use 120s timeout. Index build for swsh3 is quick (~226 fingerprints) and leaves scanner.status['running']=False afterwards; subsequent /api/scan/index calls return 200.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found; the two initial test failures were test-side issues (email case sensitivity + confidence field location) that were fixed in backend_test.py.
